main.description: Policy for a space that defers each user access decision to an external managing app via com.atproto.managedspace.checkUserAccess.

managingApp.description: Service identifier (a DID with a service fragment) of the application that decides user access for this space.

publishPolicy.description: Publish the policy to readers as a com.atproto.space.policy record in the authority's own repo in the space.
